description: This file defines the API for ADPCM encoding and decoding, including data types, function prototypes, and data structures necessary for audio data processing within the XR Voice SDK.
published: int32_t adpcm_decode(adpcm_dec_t *, adpcm_t *, uint32_t, pcm_t *, uint32_t, xraudio_adpcm_frame_t *, bool)

methods.name: adpcm_decode_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ADPCM decoder. Returns a pointer to the decoder or NULL if creation fails.

methods.name: adpcm_deframe
methods.description: Removes framing from an ADPCM packet based on provided framing details, returning the payload size or -1 on failure.

methods.name: adpcm_analyze
methods.description: Analyzes an ADPCM packet for issues such as packet loss or header mismatches; determines if decoding should proceed.

methods.name: adpcm_decode
methods.description: Decodes an ADPCM frame into PCM samples, considering endianness, and returns the number of samples decoded or -1 on failure.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_stats
methods.description: Retrieves decoding statistics from the decoder instance.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and statistics for reuse in subsequent decoding sessions.

methods.name: adpcm_decode_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and destroys the decoder instance.
